content: Plannotator (backnotprop, OSS 2026): browser UI for reviewing AI coding-agent plans/diffs. User selects text to comment/delete/replace or edits markdown; exports ANCHORED feedback as structured Markdown including selected text, comment/deletion, source line info, and direct edits as UNIFIED DIFF. Claude Code integration intercepts ExitPlanMode hook. Runs fully local, no network. Single-layer English, dev-team focused, no native-language layer, no cards, no clipper. Closest F4 comparable.
